## What Asith does

Asith leads product design for B2B SaaS and enterprise software. His work combines product strategy, UX engineering, design systems, implementation context, AI product strategy, go-to-market strategy, ESG, and sustainability. He is strongest on complex workflows that need to become clear, usable products.

## Career context

- Current: Founder, WizLabs Pvt Ltd. Building WizPos, an AI-first POS and hospitality operations ecosystem.
- Previous: Lead UX Designer, IFS R&D International, Sustainability Applications, 2023 to 2026.
- Previous: Senior UI/UX Engineer, Dialog Axiata Ideamart, 2019 to 2023.
- Previous: UX/UI Developer, John Keells IT / JKCS, 2016 to 2019.
